channel.title: Miami Sports Desk
channel.description: Daily morning roundup and 30-minute pregame drops for the Dolphins, Hurricanes, Heat, Panthers, Marlins, Inter Miami and FIU, built from the reporters who cover them.
channel.itunes:author: Hark

item.title: Lineups: Panthers at Penguins — Warmups confirm projected lines for Black's debut
item.description: Florida's warmup lines matched the projection, with Cole Reinhardt and Uvis Balinskis in and Radko Gudas and Sandis Vilmanis out. Cooper Black started in goal for his NHL debut. Music: "Funk Game Loop" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Pregame: Panthers at Penguins, 7:00 PM — Cooper Black makes NHL debut as tallest goalie ever
item.description: Cooper Black, listed at six-foot-nine, makes his NHL debut in goal for Florida against Arturs Silovs and the slumping Penguins. Projected lines, injuries and MoneyPuck numbers that point to bad luck for the 5-3-2 Panthers. Music: "Funk Game Loop" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Morning Roundup: Thu, Oct 22 — Heat's Giannis debut ends in a blowout
item.description: The Heat lost 131-106 to Minnesota in Giannis Antetokounmpo's debut, and the Panthers fell 5-1 in Brady Tkachuk's return to Ottawa. Plus Canes-Pitt, Dolphins-Jets and tonight's Panthers game. Music: "Movement Proposition" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Lineups: Timberwolves at Heat — Giannis and Bam start the opener
item.description: Official starting fives for the season opener: the Heat go with their preseason five, and Minnesota starts Ball, Edwards, McDaniels, Kuminga and Gobert with DiVincenzo out. Music: "Movement Proposition" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Pregame: Panthers at Senators and Timberwolves at Heat, 7:30 PM — Schmid starts in Tkachuk's Ottawa return; Giannis debuts
item.description: Akira Schmid starts in goal as Brady Tkachuk plays in Ottawa for the first time since the trade, with Jacob Markstrom out. Giannis Antetokounmpo makes his Heat debut in the opener against Minnesota, and Vlad Goldin is available. Music: "Movement Proposition" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Morning Roundup: Wed, Oct 21 — Heat open with Giannis; Markstrom out for the Panthers
item.description: The Heat open the season tonight with Giannis Antetokounmpo's debut, while the Panthers lose Jacob Markstrom for 10-14 days on Brady Tkachuk's Ottawa homecoming night. Also FIU's home loss to Middle Tennessee, the Canes' Pitt week and the Dolphins' kicker change. Today's edition is written in the style of a nineties sports-radio update. Music: "Volatile Reaction" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Pregame: Middle Tennessee at FIU, 7:00 PM — Carrie out, Lyons carries the load
item.description: FIU (3-3) hosts Middle Tennessee (3-3) at 7 PM on CBSSN: Anthony Carrie and Shamir Sterlin are out per Kevin Barral, Miguel Cedeno debuts on the line, and Devonte Lyons leads the run game. Under the hood, SP+ has FIU's defense 52nd against an MTSU defense ranked 127th. Music: "Vivacity" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Morning Roundup: Tue, Oct 20 — No. 1 Canes turn to Pitt
item.description: The Hurricanes are No. 1 after beating Florida State in double overtime, and Pitt is next. Heat and Panthers open Wednesday, Tkachuk is NHL first star, and Messi scored twice for Inter Miami. Music: "Vivacity" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (tempo slowed for this show)

item.title: Morning Roundup: Mon, Oct 19 — Miami Is No. 1
item.description: The Hurricanes climb to No. 1 after a double-overtime win over FSU, the Panthers make hat trick history, and Messi stars again for Inter Miami. Music: "Movement Proposition" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Morning Roundup: Sun, Oct 18 — Canes survive FSU in double OT; Panthers make hat trick history
item.description: No. 3 Miami beat Florida State 43-35 in double overtime to stay unbeaten, the Panthers routed Seattle 8-3 with NHL-record hat tricks, and Messi's two goals lifted Inter Miami. Music: "Funk Game Loop" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Lineups: Inter Miami at Atlanta United — Messi starts, same XI as Wednesday
item.description: Official starting elevens for Inter Miami at Atlanta United: Messi starts and Kily González keeps the eleven that beat NYCFC. Music: "Volatile Reaction" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Pregame: Seminoles at Hurricanes, 7:00 PM + Inter Miami at Atlanta, 7:30 PM — Rain, no lightning, nine Noles out
item.description: Final ACC availability report, Hard Rock weather and the under-the-hood numbers for Canes-Noles; projected Inter Miami XI with Messi set to start at Atlanta. Music: "Volatile Reaction" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Pregame: Kraken at Panthers, 6:00 PM — Brady Tkachuk chases a third straight hat trick
item.description: Brady Tkachuk goes for an NHL-first third straight hat trick as Jacob Markstrom returns in goal for Florida against Seattle. Plus Gudas out, Reinhardt recalled, MoneyPuck's under-the-hood look and Mackie Samoskevich's return. Music: "Volatile Reaction" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Big Game: Florida State at Miami — Kromah's Ground Game vs. the Nation's Best Run Defense
item.description: Undefeated No. 3 Miami hosts 3-3 Florida State in a sold-out, rain-threatened rivalry game at Hard Rock Stadium. Series history, the three matchups that decide it, the advanced numbers, injuries, beat-reporter reads and the show's lean. Music: "Volatile Reaction" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Morning Roundup: Sat, Oct 17 — Rivalry night, Canes host FSU
item.description: No. 3 Miami hosts Florida State tonight at Hard Rock Stadium, the Panthers host Seattle after Brady Tkachuk's back-to-back hat tricks, and Inter Miami visits Atlanta. Plus the Heat's preseason finale, the Dolphins' bye-week ownership news and the day's pregame drops. Music: "Volatile Reaction" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0, http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

item.title: Pregame: Heat at Magic, 7:00 PM — No Giannis, No Bam in the Finale
item.description: Giannis Antetokounmpo sits and Bam Adebayo and Dru Smith didn't travel as the Heat close the preseason in Orlando with Mitchell, Thompson, Wiggins, Jovic and Portis starting. Plus TV and radio, the numbers under the hood, and Davion Mitchell's breakout camp.

item.title: Morning Roundup: Fri, Oct 16 — Tkachuk's second straight hat trick, Canes-FSU week
item.description: Brady Tkachuk scored another natural hat trick, this one in overtime to beat Vancouver. Plus Heat at Orlando tonight, Canes-FSU week, Miguel Rojas retires, and Dolphins bye-week notes.

item.title: Pregame: Canucks at Panthers, 7:00 PM — Schmid Again, Power Play Heating Up
item.description: Akira Schmid starts again as the Panthers finally play at home against a Canucks team that has lost five straight in regulation. Lines, injuries, Filip Chytil's season debut, and why the numbers say Florida has been unlucky at five on five.

item.title: Morning Roundup: Thu, Oct 15 — Giannis' historic preseason line
item.description: Giannis posts 20-15-9-3 in 24 minutes in the Heat's preseason win, Inter Miami clinches a playoff spot, and the Tkachuks power the Panthers ahead of tonight's Canucks game. Plus the Canes' availability report for FSU.

item.title: Pregame: Nets at Heat and NYCFC at Inter Miami, 7:30 PM — Bam sits, a win clinches
item.description: Bam Adebayo and Pelle Larsson are out for the Heat's final home exhibition, while Giannis, Klay, Wiggins and Mitchell are expected to play. Inter Miami runs back Saturday's XI with Messi, Suárez and Berterame, and a win over NYCFC clinches a playoff spot.

item.title: Morning Roundup: Wed, Oct 14 — Tkachuk hat trick, Hill verdict, FSU week
item.description: Brady Tkachuk's natural hat trick powers the Panthers past Columbus, and a jury finds Tyreek Hill liable on two battery counts. Plus FIU's last-second loss, Canes FSU week, and tonight's Heat and Inter Miami games.

item.title: Pregame: FIU at Jacksonville State, 8:00 PM — Best D in CUSA vs. Caden Creel
item.description: FIU's defense hasn't allowed a touchdown in 11 straight quarters, and it heads to Alabama to face Caden Creel and Jax State with both teams unbeaten in Conference USA. Kickoff is 8:02 PM ET on ESPNU, with expected starters, notes and storylines.

item.title: Pregame: Panthers at Blue Jackets, 6:15 PM — Schmid in net, Cooper Black called up
item.description: Akira Schmid starts in Columbus with Jacob Markström and Radko Gudas day-to-day, and rookie Cooper Black gets his first NHL call-up as the backup. Plus Cam Talbot for Columbus, Reinhart's power-play record, and a Panthers team still chasing its first lead-protecting night.

item.title: Morning Roundup: Tue, Oct 13 — Hafley sticks with Willis
item.description: The 0-5 Dolphins enter the bye with Malik Willis still the starter, the Canes get four defenders back for FSU, and the Panthers lost Markström early in a 5-3 loss at Buffalo. Tonight: Panthers at Columbus at 6:15 and FIU at Jacksonville State at 8.

item.title: Test: Miami Sports Desk is live
item.description: A short test episode. The first morning roundup drops at 7 AM ET.
